extracted.intended_audience: applicants, patent agents and attorneys preparing or prosecuting international (PCT) applications in the international phase
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural and substantive requirements and quality standards for preparing, filing, correcting and prosecuting international (PCT) applications during the international phase.

rubrics_metrics.name: Abstract — content and drafting
rubrics_metrics.description: Abstract as element of IA: content of abstract; drafting of abstract; abstract must consist of summary of disclosure in description, claims and drawings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: References: 5.010-5.012, 5.164-5.173, 5.165-5.169; abstract drafting guidance (5.165-5.169), figure to be published with abstract (5.087, 5.170, 5.171), length of abstract (5.169A), defective or missing abstract provisions (5.173, 7.022), correction following ISA approval (5.174), physical requirements and placement in IA (5.172, 5.011).

rubrics_metrics.name: Abstract — English-language translation and figures
rubrics_metrics.description: English-language translation of abstract and indication of figure to be published with abstract.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See: 9.017, 9.018 for English translation; figure to be published with abstract: 5.087, 5.170, 5.171. Also note reference signs in abstract (5.171A) and physical requirements (5.172).

rubrics_metrics.name: Access to IA/IPE/IPRP files
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and conditions for third-party and authority access to the international application (IA), ISA/IPEA files and IPRP (Chapter II) documents, before and after publication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See: access to IA by third parties (after publication) 11.073; before publication 6.004, 11.072; access to IA file at IB 9.025, 11.073; access to IPE file 10.003, 10.081, 11.074; to ISA file 11.072, 11.073; to IPRP Chapter II and related docs 9.027, 10.003, 10.080, 11.074; access to written opinion of ISA 7.028.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agent / Appointment / Representation
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements and procedures for appointment, form, language and registration of agents, sub-agents and common representatives; letters accompanying appointment and possible reasons for appointment/refusal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: References: general agent provisions 5.041-5.047, 10.021, 11.001-11.014; form and language 9.004-9.011, 9.005; letter must accompany agent appointment 9.005-9.006A, 9.009A-9.010; registration with RO 5.043; recording changes 11.018; revocation/renunciation 5.045, 11.011-11.014. See also power_of_attorney and common representative rules (11.001-11.009).

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant(s) — identification, signatures and entitlement
rubrics_metrics.description: How applicants are identified in the IA and Request/Demand forms, signature requirements on the IA, entitlement to file a demand, and related recording/registration obligations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See: signature of applicant on IA 5.089; identification in request Box No. III 5.035; entitlement to file demand 10.004; registration of applicants with IPEA/RO 10.017, 5.024; recording changes 11.018-11.022; special rules for multiple applicants and corporate applicants at 5.034, 5.039.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendments during the international phase
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedural rules and limits for making amendments to the international application (description, claims, drawings) during the international phase.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: General amendment provisions 11.045-11.047; amendment of description during international phase 5.111; Art. 19 and Art. 34 amendment procedures (9.004-9.011, 10.024-10.028); amendments must not go beyond disclosure in the IA (9.009, 10.070, 11.047).

rubrics_metrics.name: Biological material deposit and related statements
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for deposit of biological material, accession numbers, availability to experts/third parties, timing for furnishing samples and references in the IA, demand and national phase.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See: deposit rules 11.075-11.087, Annex L; accession number 11.078(iii); availability of sample to experts 11.087 and to third parties 11.086; prescribed contents and timing 11.075, 11.078-11.081; reference to deposit in IA and demand 11.075, 11.078, 11.079, 10.019-10.023; national requirements in Annexes B, L.

rubrics_metrics.name: Claims — form, categories and amendments
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for drafting claims (including dependent and multiple dependent claims), physical/formal requirements of claims, and amendment procedures applying to claims.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: General claim guidance 5.112-5.127; dependent and multiple dependent claims 5.127, 5.113; amendment issues 9.004-9.011, 11.045-11.047; physical requirements 5.124; categories of claims in IA 5.116; SISA/SISA-related filing rules 8.003, Annex SISA.

rubrics_metrics.name: Confidentiality of IA and IPE
rubrics_metrics.description: Confidentiality protections and access limitations for the international application (IA) and international preliminary examination (IPE) files.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Confidentiality of IA: 6.004, 11.072-11.073; confidentiality of IPE: 10.003, 10.081, 11.074. See Access section for who may obtain copies and when.

rubrics_metrics.name: Correction and rectification of defects
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for correcting defects in the Request, Demand and other documents, extension of time limits for correction, and when corrections do not require fees.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Correction of defects in request 6.024-6.056; in demand 10.047-10.050; in request for SIS 8.032-8.034; extension of time limits 6.037, 6.053; no fee required for certain corrections 6.053; presentation of corrections 6.052; rectification/obvious mistakes 11.033-11.044, 5.110.

rubrics_metrics.name: Description — content, physical requirements and drafting
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for the description portion of the IA: headings, level of detail, physical requirements, inclusion of reference signs and national practice considerations when drafting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: General description provisions 5.094-5.111; amendment of description 5.111; headings in description 5.094; inclusion of list of reference signs 5.160; national practice should be considered 5.095; physical requirements 5.105-5.109; rectification of obvious mistakes 5.110.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deposit-related documentary references and effect
rubrics_metrics.description: How references to deposited biological material are to be made in the IA, the legal effect of such references, and related national differences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reference to deposited material defined 11.075; effect of reference 11.076; furnished separately from description and included in published IA 11.075; national requirements in Annexes B, L; timing and arguments relating to deposit 11.078-11.081, Annex L.

rubrics_metrics.name: Demand (for IPE) — contents, competent IPEA and defects
rubrics_metrics.description: What the demand must contain, the competent IPEA(s) to select, where to submit amendments (Art. 19), and procedure for defects in demand including loss of effect.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: General demand provisions 10.004-10.050; contents of demand 10.012-10.013; election of States in demand 10.005, 10.029; competent IPEA(s) 10.006, 10.009; defects and correction 10.046-10.050; submission of Art. 19 amendments with demand 9.010.

rubrics_metrics.name: Designated Office / Designated States — processing and requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Obligations and rights of Designated Offices/States regarding processing of national phase entry, additional documents they may require, and timing/processing restrictions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: DO may require further documents for Rule 4.17 declarations 5.075; DO normally prohibited from processing before 30 months from priority date (5.005); DO notified of record copy receipt 9.002; DO receives IPRP Chapter I 9.001(iv); fees payable in connection with filing demand 10.035-10.043; requirements for filing designated States and elections 10.004, 10.010-10.013.

rubrics_metrics.name: Designation(s) and designation of States — form and legal effects
rubrics_metrics.description: How to make designations of States, effects of designating certain regional offices (e.g., OAPI/ARIPO), and constraints (e.g., purely ornamental designs).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Designation provisions 5.052-5.056; designation of particular regions (OAPI, ARIPO) 5.052-5.053, 4.022, 4.025; design (ornamental) not within scope of PCT 5.002; where designations may be submitted 10.006-10.009; identification of designated States and related timing 5.033, 10.010.

rubrics_metrics.name: Declarations under Rule 4.17 — entitlement and inventorship
rubrics_metrics.description: Standardized declarations concerning entitlement to apply for/grant of a patent, priority entitlement, non-prejudicial disclosures and identity of inventor; correction and addition procedures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Declarations under Rule 4.17 for entitlement, priority, non-prejudicial disclosures, identity of inventor 5.074; correction or addition of declarations 5.083A, 6.045, 6.047; publication and receipt provisions 9.013-9.017, 10.051.

rubrics_metrics.name: Defects — influence on international filing date and correction mechanisms
rubrics_metrics.description: Types of defects in the IA, Request, Demand or priority claim that may or may not influence the international filing date, plus mechanisms and time limits for correction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defects influencing international filing date 6.012, 6.025-6.026; defects not influencing date 6.032; incorporation by reference of missing elements 6.012, 6.024-6.031; defects in abstract 5.173, 7.022; correction of defects generally 6.024-6.056.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosure limits — amendments must not add new matter
rubrics_metrics.description: Amendments to the IA are restricted so they must not go beyond the disclosure of the international application (no new matter).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Amendments are not to go beyond disclosure in IA: 9.009, 10.070, 11.047; see also rules on new matter and rectification/obvious mistakes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Citations and documentation availability (ISR/IPRP/SISR)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements that ISR, SISR and IPRP contain citations of relevant documents and the procedures for obtaining copies of documents cited in ISR/IPRP/SISR.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ISR citation rules 7.024; availability of copies cited in ISR 7.026-7.032; IPRP citation rules 10.075 and availability of copies 10.082; SISR citation/availability 8.050.

rubrics_metrics.name: Copies and certified copies — availability and use
rubrics_metrics.description: When and how certified copies or other copies of earlier applications and of the IA are used, furnished, or substituted (e.g., record copy, home copy, search copy).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Certified copy of earlier application 5.070-5.070D; certified copy of IA transmitted in lieu of record copy 6.058; copies of IA sent by IB to DOs 9.028-9.029; obtaining copies of published IA 9.021, 11.072-11.073; copies of documents cited in ISR/IPRP available as per 7.026-7.032 and 10.082.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disparaging or improper statements prohibited in IA and amendments
rubrics_metrics.description: The IA and statements accompanying Art. 19/other amendments may not contain disparaging statements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prohibition on disparaging statements: IA may not contain disparaging statements 5.175; statement accompanying Art. 19 amendments may not contain disparaging statements 9.007.
